				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:translation kehillah_writing_translation_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_ibn_tibbon_moreh_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 knows_language = language_arabic is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim } kehillah_writing_machshava_aptitude_value >= 50 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_ibn_tibbon_moreh }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:minhag kehillah_writing_minhag_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hamanhig_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 16 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_seder_rav_amram } num_of_known_languages >= 3 kehillah_deed_ruling_ok_value >= 3 }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_sefer_hamanhig }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:grammar kehillah_writing_grammar_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_radak_shorashim_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 16 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } kehillah_lib_tanakh_rounds_value >= 2 kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value >= 45 }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_radak_shorashim }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:responsa kehillah_writing_responsa_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_responsa_maharam_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_tosafot } kehillah_lib_bavli_mastered_count_value >= 4 kehillah_deed_letter_ok_value >= 12 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_responsa_maharam }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:ethics kehillah_writing_ethics_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_maalot_hamiddot_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 15 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot } OR = { has_trait = humble has_trait = patient has_trait = temperate } kehillah_deed_sermon_ok_value >= 8 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_asceticism } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_maalot_hamiddot }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:responsa kehillah_writing_responsa_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_responsa_rashba_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_ramban_torah } kehillah_deed_letter_ok_value >= 20 kehillah_deed_ruling_ok_value >= 5 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_responsa_rashba }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue kehillah_writing_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_milhamot_hashem_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 18 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_ibn_tibbon_moreh } kehillah_writing_machshava_aptitude_value >= 60 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_milhamot_hashem }
			}
			100 = {
				trigger = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue kehillah_writing_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_etz_hayyim_karaite_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_toric_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_kitab_alanwar } OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_ibn_tibbon_moreh } } kehillah_writing_machshava_aptitude_value >= 50 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_literalism } }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_etz_hayyim_karaite }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_book_named_work } set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes } }
}

# In a project-option preview. $FORM$ is the option's form key.
kehillah_writing_landmark_hint_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { kehillah_writing_landmark_has_$FORM$_trigger = yes } } custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_none }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_writing_landmark_ready_$FORM$_trigger = yes } custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_ready }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_writing_landmark_open_$FORM$_trigger = yes } custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_open }
	else = { custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_filled }
	kehillah_writing_landmark_belief_hint_$FORM$_effect = yes
}

		limit = { kehillah_writing_talmud_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written } kehillah_writing_rashi_talmud_ready_trigger = yes NOT = { kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_thesis_work_rashi_talmud
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_writing_talmud_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written } kehillah_sefer_ambition_tosafot_trigger = yes NOT = { kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_writing.landmark_thesis_work_tosafot
	}
}
